custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an active untracked part, part A, with 4 in bin location A, 3 in bin location B, and a saved Min of 2 and Max of 6.
  • Make sure the Bin Location / Quantity, Total Qty, Min and Max columns are switched on in the columns button.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Location B is Staging Lethbridge - 4310. To switch: click the box at the top right, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Lethbridge - 4310. Switch back to Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 the same way.
  • To create a part: click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill Description and Part Number (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C154768-A for part A, -B for part B), pick a Category, type a Cost and a Sell Price, type the Quantity in the bin row (the location's bin, for example General Storage, is offered), then click Save. Leave Track quantities and cost of goods on for a tracked part; click it off for an untracked part. Add Bin Location adds a second bin; Vendor, Manufacturer, Core Charge, Min, Max and Tags are in the same window. Parts that must start with the same text all start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C154768-, so searching for that finds them all.
  • The Search box above the Inventory list opens when you click Search (the magnifier).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part A's Total Qty cell reads "Not Tracked" in grey, with no quantity badge.
  • Its Bin Location / Quantity cell still shows both bins with their quantities: bin location A with 4 and bin location B with 3.
  • Its Min cell reads 2 and its Max cell reads 6.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10817 (Story 4, Create an Untracked Part)

  • S4-R8: “An untracked part shows "Not Tracked" in the Inventory list's Total Qty column instead of a quantity.”
  • S4-R8a: “On the Inventory list, an untracked part's Bin Location / Quantity column still shows each bin with its quantity.”
  • S4-R8b: “On the Inventory list, an untracked part's Min and Max columns still show the saved values.”
  • Feature Overview, Core functionality: “An untracked part is not counted. The Inventory list shows "Not Tracked" instead of its total quantity, and its Min and Max are kept but not used. Its bins and their quantities stay on screen as a shelf reference. It can still be used on work orders and invoices.”
